title: Learner Registration (Question-File Driven)
doneMessage: Registration complete. Your answers are saved safely.

questions.label: What is your full name?
questions.helpText: Type or speak the name you want trainers to call you.
questions.whyWeAsk: Used to personalize your learning profile.

questions.label: What is your mobile number?
questions.helpText: Ethiopian numbers starting with 09, 07, or +251 are normalized automatically.
questions.whyWeAsk: So coordinators can share updates about your learning program.

questions.label: Choose an identity option
questions.helpText: No kebele ID or passport is required.
questions.whyWeAsk: Alternative verification ensures no learner is turned away.

options.label: I have no document, refer me through a partner

questions.label: Do you want any learning or access support?
questions.helpText: Kept private for your support coordinator only.
questions.whyWeAsk: Helps us prepare readable formats, extra time, or interpreters.

options.label: Screen reader, audio, or large-print materials

questions.label: Confirm registration consent
questions.helpText: I confirm my answers are accurate and understand employers never see my private support choices without my permission.
questions.whyWeAsk: Protects your privacy and ensures informed consent.
